sources.title: 据报道，由于 Nvidia Blackwell 和 Rubin 芯片对封装产能造成压力，台积电考虑将 CoWoS 价格上涨 20% / TSMC reportedly weighs 20% CoWoS price increase as Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin chips put pressure on packaging capacity
sources.title_zh: 据报道，由于 Nvidia Blackwell 和 Rubin 芯片对封装产能造成压力，台积电考虑将 CoWoS 价格上涨 20%
sources.title_en: TSMC reportedly weighs 20% CoWoS price increase as Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin chips put pressure on packaging capacity
sources.title_original: TSMC reportedly weighs 20% CoWoS price increase as Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin chips put pressure on packaging capacity
sources.summary: TSMC is reportedly weighing a price increase of up to 20% for its CoWoS advanced packaging technology as Nvidia’s Blackwell and upcoming Rubin chips intensify pressure on capacity. Equipment deliveries now reportedly take up to eight months, while separate wafer-price increases of 5% to 10% are expected in 2027, with some customers potentially facing total cost increases of up to 25%.
sources.summary_zh: 据报道，由于 Nvidia 的 Blackwell 和即将推出的 Rubin 芯片加大了产能压力，台积电正在考虑将其 CoWoS 先进封装技术的价格上涨最多 20%。据报道，设备交付目前需要长达 8 个月的时间，而预计 2027 年晶圆价格将单独上涨 5% 至 10%，一些客户可能面临高达 25% 的总成本上涨。
